name: lasagna
description: Install, update, configure, and monitor Lasagna workspaces. Lasagna is a fork of Pappardelle (github.com/chardigio/pappardelle). Provides /init-lasagna (interactive setup wizard), /update-lasagna (update to latest version), /configure-lasagna (interactive config editor), /sous-chef (kitchen-style workspace coordinator), /link-pr (record a PR/MR for the workspace), and lasagna-agent (workspace reference), an MCP server with tools for the companion pane and spaces, plus the hooks that report Claude status to the TUI, post question answers to the issue, and send ntfy notifications.
